breakdown: Incomplete insurance or demographic data moves forward without validation
root_cause: No required front-end checkpoint before scheduling or registration
operational_impact: Clean claim risk increases and staff must rework the account later
patient_impact: Patients may experience delayed care unexpected bills or repeated phone calls
fix: Create required field controls and a pre-visit validation checklist
portfolio_insight: Most revenue cycle breakdowns begin before the claim exists
linkedin_hook: Most denials do not start in billing. They start upstream.

breakdown: Coverage is checked too late or not rechecked before service
root_cause: Eligibility timing is disconnected from appointment and payer rule changes
operational_impact: Eligibility denials increase and A/R follow-up becomes reactive
patient_impact: Patients may believe coverage is active until a denial occurs
fix: Add same-week eligibility confirmation and exception queue review
portfolio_insight: Eligibility is not a one-time task; it is a timing-sensitive control point
linkedin_hook: Eligibility verification is a trust checkpoint not a clerical task.

breakdown: Authorization status is unclear before service delivery
root_cause: No shared visibility between scheduling clinical documentation and payer authorization requirements
operational_impact: Services may be delayed denied or routed into manual escalation
patient_impact: Patients may face appointment delays or surprise authorization issues
fix: Build an authorization tracker with owner status payer requirement due date and escalation field
portfolio_insight: Prior authorization failure is often a handoff failure
linkedin_hook: Prior auth problems are usually workflow visibility problems.

breakdown: Clinical documentation does not support the service billed
root_cause: Documentation quality checks happen after claim generation instead of before submission
operational_impact: Claim edits denials and coding rework increase
patient_impact: Patients may experience billing delays or confusing claim outcomes
fix: Add pre-bill documentation completeness review for high-risk services
portfolio_insight: Documentation quality is revenue integrity infrastructure
linkedin_hook: Documentation gaps become financial friction later.

breakdown: Denials are worked individually without pattern tracking
root_cause: No root-cause coding or trend review across denial types
operational_impact: The same denial conditions repeat and team capacity is drained
patient_impact: Patients may face longer resolution times and repeated account confusion
fix: Create denial reason categories and weekly root-cause review
portfolio_insight: Denial management should feed denial prevention
linkedin_hook: Every denial is a workflow signal if it is categorized correctly.
